issues.claim: CAI-NJ is the cheapest formal vendor seat in property management at $685 a year
issues.problem: Contradicted by the brief's own figures: NJAA Supplier Partner dues are $650 ($675 with the $25 processing fee), which is less than CAI-NJ's $685. The $685 figure itself is correct; only the 'cheapest' superlative is wrong.
issues.fix: Delete 'cheapest' or reword to 'CAI-NJ's $685 business partner seat is roughly level with NJAA's $650-$675 supplier seat, and gives a national membership with the NJ chapter included'.

issues.claim: Community Trends ad deadlines: 'Deadlines are the 15th of the prior month'
issues.problem: The rate card says the 15th of the prior month 'EXCEPT the October issue deadline is TBD in Aug. 2026'. The brief omits the exception while recommendation 7 proposes starting with the October issue.
issues.fix: Add the October exception to the finding; in the recommendation, tell the buyer to ask for the October deadline in August 2026 rather than assuming a 15th-of-prior-month cutoff.

issues.claim: NJAA sponsorship finding quotes the brochure and the 'NJAA log-in and password required to view and purchase' line, cited to the 2026 sponsorship PDF
issues.problem: Citation mismatch: the $500/$750 line items are in the PDF as stated, but the log-in/password quote and the 'outlines every opportunity ... including benefits, pricing, and visibility details' line appear on https://www.njaa.com/conference-and-expo-sponsors, not in the PDF.
issues.fix: Cite https://www.njaa.com/conference-and-expo-sponsors for the log-in and brochure quotes, keeping the PDF for the prices.

issues.claim: The NJSBA Annual Meeting is 'the highest-reach legal event in the state'
issues.problem: Unsupported superlative. The prospectus states 'some 3,000' attendees but no other event's attendance is cited, so 'highest-reach in the state' is an unlabelled comparison.
issues.fix: Say 'one of the largest legal events in the state (about 3,000 attendees per the 2026 prospectus)' or label the comparison as an inference.

issues.claim: NJ Food Council contact email njfc@njfoodcouncil.com (data_gaps and the NJ Food Council resource)
issues.problem: The 609-392-8899 phone number is confirmed on njfoodcouncil.com/index.php/about/contact-us, but the email address is obfuscated on that page ('this email address is being protected from spambots') and I could not confirm it on any page I opened.
issues.fix: Cite only the phone number, or state the email as 'listed on the council's contact page (email shielded behind a form)' so it is not presented as read from the page.

issues.claim: 'The NJ Food Council's event calendar is concentrated within about 20 minutes of Milltown'
issues.problem: Labelled as an inference, which is acceptable, but Somerset Park is a longer drive than 20 minutes from Milltown, so the framing is generous.
issues.fix: Soften to 'most NJFC events are in Middlesex or Somerset County, within roughly 20-35 minutes of Milltown (inference)'.
